problem: Public recover cannot name original framework successor even though no-write normal producer may leave no catalog renewal history carrying binding. Original framework recovery deliberately retains coordination/scaffolds, so earlier catalog census needs explicit original successor proof; active ownership patch is not sufficient to recover.
recommended_public_command_sequence: litai project layout recover --place-framework-authority --acknowledge --plan-identity FRAMEWORK_ID --project ROOT
litai project layout recover --acknowledge --plan-identity CATALOG_ID --successor-plan-identity FRAMEWORK_ID --project ROOT

minimal_wiring.change: Retain --place-imported-catalogs for renew/finalize only. Separately admit --successor-plan-identity for recover/renew/finalize. No new recover scope selector; existing acknowledged catalog plan ID selects original journal.

Forward explicit optional successor keyword only to recover_legacy_layout_migration. Reject successor with --place-framework-authority on recover upfront (existing scope rejection currently only renew/finalize). Preserve acknowledgement required and existing scope restrictions. Do not route recover through manifest discovery/root helper; manifest can be backed up in original transaction.

Add keyword-only successor_plan_identity=None. Within same original layout lock and explicit exact catalog-journal branch pass original option through. If no catalog continuation and option supplied, refuse before legacy _rollback; do not silently ignore or scan unrelated journals. Legacy no-option behavior preserved.

Optional exact successor ID defaultNone; capture original current layout lease from existing held lock once. Decode selected original catalog intent first; original successor owner proves explicitly named framework journal in recovering direction. Thread same acquired lease, namespace, original binding, recovering=True to initial _load->_guard_journal and every _current before/after effects/markers/retained census. Do not acquire a replacement lease from serialized data or add broad global journal exceptions.

Current constructor validates active placement only. Extend original finite owner with explicit keyword recovering=False, exact bool validation and delegate to original require_catalog_successor(...recovering=recovering); recovery requires original framework rollback and original native handoff. Runtime reviewer owns exact cross-journal/member proof and closure guards.

input_contract: Only None means no requested successor; explicit empty/malformed/foreign identity must refuse, not disappear via truthiness. Reuse original canonical identity/journal owner validation, with inert exact string/type checks before foreign behavior.
Exact expected catalog identity remains mandatory; second identity names bounded original framework successor, not arbitrary search/discovery or payload permission.
Acknowledgement is still required for both scope recoveries. Wrong recovery order must refuse before moves/markers, retaining original histories/live pair.
Root path semantics retained: recovery must function with original manifest unavailable; no new descendant-discovery promise.

result_schema_contract.reason: Existing catalog continuation result@1 already covers operation=recover, unchanged nested original plan, rolled_back=true, retained_scaffolding bounded unique litai ancestors of original selected destinations, qualification=false/full_containment=false. Runtime proof may retain only original catnewdirs intersect exact successor-originaldirs/coordination; if those stay selected destination ancestors existing codec/schema apply.
preserve: Do not mutate acknowledged historical plan/journal to add retrospective approval.
Do not add successor binding to public result without deliberate codec/schema review; invocation flag itself needs no result version.
A valid result remains data only; no lease/source actor revived.

documentation_guidance: Update docs/user/project-layout.md334-343 to show framework rollback first, then catalog rollback explicitly naming same reviewed framework successor ID even if normal producer made no lock/audit writes.
Describe omitted option only for no-successor catalog histories; do not promise automatic discovery of all framework journals.
Explain retained_scaffolding as bounded original owner coordination/necessary still-recorded shared parents; unrelated files refuse and gain no payload or deletion permission.
Existing normal renewal/finalization successor commands395/404 remain; make recovery example consistent, preserve pending qualification/fullcontainment limits.
No separate guidance generator advertises this option in inspected call paths; parser help plus authoritative user layout docs are immediate owners.

recommended_existing_tests.purpose: Cold public CLI original both-write finalization/recovery: framework then catalog, exact successor option only catalog, repeat each twice; every original byte/inode/authored/Git assertion retained. Add true no-write producer path with zero catalog-renewal journals before recovery.
Shared recovery helper passes exact framework identity to catalog recovery after framework undo. Retain changed/missing/foreign journal source and original inode assertions.

Wrong-order refusal before any effect; exact successor postimage join; equal-byte foreign beforeimage; replaced original guard never invoked; interrupted child backups recover; wrong/missing successor/foreign pair/root histories refuse without mutation. Preserve original v1 no-successor recovery case.
No-successor original direct API and fresh-process recovery remain unchanged; exact acknowledged source/history/receipt bytes recovered.

Recover accepts explicit canonical successor; framework+successor rejects before native recovery; noncatalog legacy+successor refuses before _rollback; missing acknowledgement/wrong exact ID malformed ID refuse. No importedcatalog flag added accidentally.

review_limits: No source/test edits or qualification runs; current active patch reviewed only to design exact API/context wiring.
Cross-journal retained-member proof and new directories/scaffolding admission require independent runtime reviewer source closure.
Public/no-write recovery acceptance and fresh frozen cohorts remain pending; no actual historical apply/recovery performed by reviewer.
